texts.preamble: M.Thangaraj vs The District Designated Officer on 29 September, 2021 Author: Senthilkumar Ramamoorthy Bench: Senthilkumar Ramamoorthy W.P(Md Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated : 29.09.2021 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice Senthilkumar Ramamoorthy W.P(MD).No.17503 of 2021 M.Thangaraj ... Vs. 1.The District Designated Officer, Food Safety Department , No.239, 2nd Floor, Collector Office, Sivagangai . 2.The Food Safety Officer, Fso Code No.198, Kallal & Thiruppathur Block, Sivagangai District. ... Res Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondent shift / remove 28 tea particle bundles form the petitioner's house situa 4/4/3/2, Akilmanai Street, Thiruppathur, Sivagangai District, which was sealed by the 2nd respondent at the time of seizure on 04.12.2018, by considering his representation dated 14.09.2021. For Petitioner : Mr.T.Lenin Kumar
texts.facts: The petitioner seeks a direction for shifting or removing 28 bundles containing tea particles from his house at No.4/4/3/2, Akilmanai Street, Thiruppathur, Sivagangai District. 2.The petitioner states that he is a lessee of the above mentioned property. He was in the business of retail sale of tea. For such purpose, 28 bundles containing tea particles weighing about 1 ton were stored in his house on 04.12.2018. The second respondent inspected his house and seized the said bundles on the alleged ground that the relevant products were unsafe and mis-branded. Private complaints in S.T.C.Nos.1176 and 1177 of 2019 are pending in connection with such seizure before the District Munsif Cum Judicial Magistrate, Thiruppathur, Sivagangai District. 3.Meanwhile, the petitioner states that the landlord has called upon the petitioner to vacate the relevant premises. In addition, it is stated that the seized goods are perishable in nature and, therefore, the said goods should be destroyed or removed from the premises. On account of the storage of such https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis/ goods for a considerable period of time, it is stated that the entire area is infested by insects and the like.
